label: Brow shelf

range.endpoint_anchor: ledge/sulcus index (no published chord isolates it; ordered design values on sourced morphology): -20 = pooled modern [E], 0 = mild modern ledge, +100 = gorilla [E]

region.mask_rule: frontal bone band + post-toral sulcus above the orbits; bone-led layer of the layered head stack

semantics: The ledge geometry: how far the brow's inferior edge overhangs the orbit, how deep the post-toral sulcus cuts, how recessed the orbital opening sits. More than projection, this is what makes eyes read deep-set. 0 = mild modern ledge; pooled modern -20 [E]; gorilla +100 [E]; orc +90 [E]. No canid/felid torus exists, so this slider does the honest brow work for animal presets (species-head-spec.md section 3.1). Bone-led: tissue may soften the edge by at most the BrowPadding depth. A bone-led slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
